result.content:
Done. Summary of the work:

**Fault found** — `packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts:112`, in `migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot()`:

```ts
// before (buggy)                              // after (fixed)
.replace(/[/:]/g, "-")                        .replace(/[/\\:]/g, "-")
```

The replacement character class omitted the backslash, so a Windows session header `C:\Users\dev\project` produced a directory like `--C-\Users\dev\project--` (a legal Linux name, an invalid Windows one) instead of the canonical `--C--Users-dev-project--`. UNC cwds were equally wrong. The repaired expression now matches the canonical encoders already present at `core/session-manager.ts:592` and `agent/src/harness/session/jsonl/repo.ts:37` (strip exactly one leading separator, then map every `/`, `\`, `:` to `-`).

No other production change was required — the function already ignores unparsable/non-`session`/cwd-less headers, moves files with `renameSync` (bytes preserved verbatim), skips `if (existsSync(newPath)) continue;`, and is idempotent because migrated files leave the agent root.

**Validation** — `.prale-eval/regression.mjs` loads the real `migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot()` via `createGraph()` from `subject.mjs`, with hand-written boundary fakes for `./config.ts`, `./core/keybindings.ts`, `./utils/text.ts`, and `chalk` (builtin `fs`/`path` real):
- POSIX, drive-letter (both separator styles, lowercase), UNC, single-leading-backslash, and trailing-separator cwds each land in exactly one directory equal to an independently implemented spec encoding, byte-identical, source removed
- invalid headers (non-JSON, wrong type, missing cwd, blank first line) untouched and no `sessions/` created
- valid session migrates alongside an invalid one
- existing destination never overwritten, source preserved
- two consecutive runs produce identical byte-level tree snapshots (Windows + UNC)
- missing agent root is a no-op

`node --experimental-vm-modules .prale-eval/regression.mjs` → exit 0. With the original faulty line temporarily restored it exits 1 with `AssertionError: cwd "C:\\Users\\dev\\project" must migrate to sessions/--C--Users-dev-project--/session.jsonl (found ["--C-\\Users\\dev\\project--"])`. Scratch dirs are cleaned on exit; no residue.

`.prale-eval/result.json` was re-read and verified: `task_id` = `session-migration/transfer`, `repository` = `earendil-works/pi`, `mode` = `repair`, `validation.command` exactly `node --experimental-vm-modules .prale-eval/regression.mjs`, `status` = `passed`, substantive notes (including the recorded limitation that the repo's vitest suites can't run because `node_modules` is absent, and dependencies must not be installed). Only `migrations.ts` plus the two new `.prale-eval/` files changed.
